entities.summary: Mira Kuisma is a Finnish retired ice hockey goaltender and current head coach of the Finnish women's national under-18 ice hockey team and Team Kuortane of the Naisten Liiga. During her playing career, she was a member of the Finnish national team and won bronze medals at the 2010 Winter Olympics and 2009 IIHF Women's World Championship.
